module: Make and maintain the deployment decision

lesson.title: Inform workers, affected people and public deployers
lesson.summary: Distinguish workplace, public-registration and affected-person information gates.

prerequisites.reason: The employer is a deployer The actor's deployer status matters.
The Annex III route is required.
The notice concerns a proposed deployment. It concerns the actual deployment

blocks: **Workplace information** is required before an employer puts a high-risk system into service or uses it at work. Inform workers’ representatives and affected workers that they will be subject to its use.

Apply relevant Union/national worker-information rules and procedures where applicable. A notice after use begins does not meet the stated before-use timing. Specific national procedures need a separately sourced jurisdiction check.

**Public-deployer registration** applies to public authorities and Union institutions, bodies, offices or agencies through Article 49. If such a deployer finds its proposed high-risk system unregistered in the relevant EU database, it must not use it and must inform provider or distributor.

Determine the applicable registration route and any protected database arrangements rather than relying only on a public search page. Our public-authority case expressly stipulates that required registration is missing.

**Affected-person information** under 26(11) concerns Annex III high-risk systems making or assisting decisions about natural persons. Inform those persons that they are subject to use of the high-risk system.

It is separate from Article 50’s interaction and content notices. The law-enforcement qualification refers to Article 13 of the Law Enforcement Directive; do not copy an ordinary recruitment notice into that specialist context without checking it.
Deployers also cooperate with competent authorities in actions implementing the Regulation. Put each information/cooperation task against its own actor, recipient, trigger and timing.

Case: informing workers does not automatically inform job applicants affected by an Annex III assisted decision. A private employer is not a public authority merely because its recruitment affects people. Keep the three gates distinct.
